entities.title: MEG: The Current Remembers
entities.summary: An original cartoon shark game for the browser, desktop and phone: the player is the last megalodon, eating fish and swimmers and hiding in a warm current from the Directorate across eight levels.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the page, its stylesheet and the game script in public/, the Worker that serves them behind the sign-in and keeps the shared high-score table in worker/, and the tests in test/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
The shared table lives in a Durable Object, not a D1 database; scores are trusted within checked limits (decisions.json). The page loads three Google Fonts and nothing else from outside.
